Container.Name: curtain
Container.Overview:
curtain is a public-facing, read-only dashboard for your Unraid server. It shows visitors a curated, admin-approved view: live metrics (CPU load, memory, uptime, disk), a storage breakdown pie, quick links to your public services, and optionally posters for the three most recently added movies.
SECURITY: curtain is intentionally UNAUTHENTICATED - treat everything it serves as public. It is read-only by design (no write/control endpoints), reads only the specific env vars you set (an allowlist - it never enumerates the environment), and sees only the host paths you bind-mount READ-ONLY. Run it non-root with no added capabilities (this template does). Only mount what you are comfortable exposing, and do not expose it to the internet without a reverse proxy you trust.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the dashboard is served on.

Config.Name: Contact URL
Config.Description: Optional footer link to your site/portfolio. Must be http(s); invalid URLs are dropped.

Config.Name: Contact Label
Config.Description: Optional text for the contact link.

Config.Name: Disk Path
Config.Description: In-container path whose filesystem total/free drives the Disk metric and the pie's Free/Other. Point it at one of the mounted paths below.

Config.Name: Movies Path (Recently Added)
Config.Description: In-container path to the movie library used for the 'Recently Added' posters. Leave as /data/movies to reuse the Movies mount below; unset to disable the feature.

Config.Name: TMDB API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Used server-side only (never sent to the browser) to fetch a poster when a movie has no local poster image. Leave blank to use local posters only.

Config.Name: Storage 1 Path
Config.Description: In-container path measured for wedge 1 (matches the Movies mount).

Config.Name: Storage 2 Path
Config.Description: In-container path measured for wedge 2 (matches the Shows mount).

Config.Name: Storage 3 Path
Config.Description: In-container path measured for wedge 3 (optional; add a matching mount).

Config.Name: Link 1 URL
Config.Description: Quick link 1 URL. Must be http(s).

Config.Name: Link 1 Icon
Config.Description: Quick link 1 icon. Local /logos/plex.png etc., or an external http(s) image URL.

Config.Name: Movies (host path)
Config.Description: Your movie library, mounted READ-ONLY. Backs the Storage 'Movies' wedge and 'Recently Added'.

Config.Name: Shows (host path)
Config.Description: Your TV library, mounted READ-ONLY. Backs the Storage 'Shows' wedge.

Config.Name: Photos (host path)
Config.Description: Optional photo library, mounted READ-ONLY (used only if you add a matching Storage 3 entry).
